title: His parents immigrated from India to Georgia. On November 3, 2026, he became the first Sikh ever elected to its state legislature.

sources.text: ThePrint - Jyot Singh scripts history as first Sikh elected to Georgia Assembly
The Quint - Jyot Singh Becomes First Sikh American To Win Georgia Assembly
American Bazaar - Jyot Singh Georgia House District 97 win coverage

caption:
His parents immigrated from India to Georgia. On November 3, 2026, he became the first Sikh ever elected to its state legislature.

Raised in Norcross, Georgia, by Sikh and Punjabi immigrant parents from India, Singh defeated Republican Yassin Moghazy in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning his Democratic primary in May 2026 with 59.1% of the vote.

His campaign centered on affordability, healthcare and housing and included events at the Guru Nanak Mission Society in Norcross - the community he grew up in now sending him to represent it statewide.

Singh's win adds a Sikh American voice to a state legislature for the first time - one more place where an Indian immigrant family's story became part of the wider story of American representation.
